records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Wanted to make sure nothing fell through the cracks during setup. If you've got five minutes, I'd love to hear how it's going.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Timber Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Customer has never replied to either outreach ([email:2f28e564], [email:8ae2836f]) and no-showed the kickoff call ([calendar:a252048d]). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Timber Ventures moving
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

I know a new tool is easy to park when the week gets busy, so no worries about the call we had on the calendar. When you do get a few minutes, the one step that makes everything else click is creating a first project -- projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. There's an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project, and inviting your team is a natural next step after that.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through that first project together.

Best,
Chidi
